items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Young kid, the first thing, 'Oh, well I got my life.'

ctx.x: Sure. You know. Sure. I mean, every time I get on a plane. Every time – I mean, I'm – You know. I'm fortunate. You know? Like I tell the boys. You know, they're, "Well, I've got time. I've got my life." I say, "Look man. Quit that crap about you got time. You don't know what you've got." You know. "Like just because you're 24 years old, you think you got for 25." You don't know. A car could hit you tomorrow. Anything could happen tomorrow. So do every day the best you can and do something to try to grow as much…
Are there any people that you'd like to pay tribute to for posterity?
